scenes.title: TouchMap
scenes.body:
Explore diagrams through touch and sound.

Built for blind and low-vision learners.

DEFOZO SOFTWARE HOUSE
Michał Kiełtyka
scenes.sourceAnnotation: Actual native Library captured after revised English entry copy, source943a5d8, HAP1cae6f5d. This records the capture artifact and does not assert later release binary identity.

narration.text: Touch an object. Hear its name. Follow its connections. This is TouchMap.

scenes.title: Bring the whole lesson
scenes.body:
Import the diagram, spoken labels, connections and questions together.

Open it without a connection.
scenes.sourceAnnotation: Actual native build 2616f496 | Edited offline verification excerpt

narration.text: For a blind or low-vision learner, a diagram can be the hardest part of a lesson. TouchMap brings the picture, spoken labels, relationships and questions into one offline package.

scenes.title: Know your material
scenes.body:
See the source and author declaration.

Choose when to start exploring.

narration.text: Start with the source and the author declaration. Check what the material contains, then accept it locally. The learner stays in control.

scenes.title: Touch an object. Hear its label.
scenes.body:
Explore the picture directly.

Use the same actions through large controls and a structured list.
scenes.annotation: TouchMap | Native emulator demo | Original app audio
scenes.sourceAnnotation: Actual emulator touch and captured QEMU audio | Build 2616f496

scenes.title: Follow the connections
scenes.body:
Move between objects.

Explore how one part relates to another.
scenes.sourceAnnotation: Actual native build 2616f496 | Edited offline verification excerpt

narration.text: Select a connection to move from one object to the next. Follow the process, or return to the part you want to explore.

scenes.title: Answer a question about the diagram
scenes.body:
Answer questions about the diagram.

Check each answer against reviewed connections.
scenes.sourceAnnotation: Actual native build 2616f496 | Developer verification, offline

narration.text: Choose an answer and submit it. TouchMap checks the reviewed diagram facts, so each result follows the lesson the author approved.

scenes.title: Keep your place
scenes.body:
An unfinished answer stays unfinished.

Save the choice and come back to it.
scenes.sourceAnnotation: Actual native build 2616f496 | No automatic submission

narration.text: Need a break? Your next selection is saved separately from your completed answers. Come back when you are ready.

scenes.title: Close it. Open it again.
scenes.body:
The app restarts.

The lesson stays with you.
scenes.sourceAnnotation: Actual native build 2616f496 | Process restart excerpt

narration.text: Even after the app stops, the lesson is still there.

scenes.title: Continue where you left off
scenes.body:
Keep the answers you completed.

Resume the question you were working on.
scenes.sourceAnnotation: Actual native build 2616f496 | Search/navigation wait omitted

narration.text: Reopen the material. Your earlier answer remains, and the new selection is waiting for you. There is no need to start the lesson again.

scenes.title: Give authors a head start
scenes.body:
Turn a source image into an editable draft.

AI proposes objects and connections for review.
scenes.annotation: TouchMap | Native emulator demo | Preparation wait omitted
scenes.sourceAnnotation: Actual native build2616f496; permission and AI-request controls at source5-19s. Same run preview at source136-143s follows; preparation wait omitted.

narration.text: For educators, preparation starts with an image. With permission, AI proposes the objects and connections. The author gets a draft to inspect and improve.

scenes.title: Check against the source
scenes.body:
Keep the original picture alongside the draft.

Review each proposed region.
scenes.sourceAnnotation: Same live AI request | Navigation and waiting omitted

narration.text: The source stays visible, so every proposed object can be checked against the picture.

scenes.title: Make the lesson precise
scenes.body:
Correct positions, labels and connections.

Confirm what each part means.
scenes.annotation: TouchMap | Native emulator demo | Earlier authoring session
scenes.sourceAnnotation: Earlier development build | Condensed developer authoring excerpt

narration.text: Adjust the regions, correct the wording, and confirm the relationships. Separate checks for geometry and meaning put the author in charge of the published lesson.

scenes.title: Give every object a voice
scenes.body:
Import recordings or generate spoken labels.

Listen before publishing.
scenes.annotation: TouchMap | Native emulator demo | Earlier authoring session
scenes.sourceAnnotation: Earlier successful speech session, build ce00562d | Edited UI excerpt

narration.text: Add recorded speech, or generate spoken labels. Listen to the important words before publishing.

scenes.title: Publish a lesson that travels
scenes.body:
A reviewed revision with local recordings.

Three objects. Two connections. One question.
scenes.sourceAnnotation: Previously published revision 6 | Viewed on build 2616f496

narration.text: The reviewed revision brings the diagram, connections, questions and recordings together. TouchMap checks the required files before marking it ready offline.

scenes.title: Share the teaching material
scenes.body:
Export the package.

Open it on a second installation, offline.
scenes.sourceAnnotation: Build a40c63d2 | Offline reimport on second installation at 200% text

narration.text: Export the package and open it on another installation. The teaching material travels with its audio.

scenes.title: Keep progress personal
scenes.body:
Share the lesson, not the learner’s history.

Reimport without losing your place.
scenes.sourceAnnotation: Same second-installation reimport | Validation and navigation wait omitted

narration.text: The package carries the lesson, while learning history stays private. Reimport the material and keep the progress already saved on that device.

scenes.title: Try the lesson yourself
scenes.body:
Import. Explore. Answer. Resume.

Download TouchMap and the sample lessons.

github.com/Defozo/TouchMap
scenes.sourceAnnotation: Developer verification across identified builds | Evidence and build guide in the repository

narration.text: TouchMap gives learners a way to explore diagrams, and educators a way to prepare them. Download the app and sample lessons. Import a diagram, follow a connection, and try the lesson yourself.
